label: Unscripted Video Production
description: Unscripted video workflow from pre-production through distribution

stages.label: Pre-production Planning
stages.subtitle: Planning & Logistics
stages.description: Define concept, locations, schedule, and budget for unscripted shoot
stages.ai: Suggests shoot locations, identifies scheduling conflicts

stages.label: Talent & Crew Coordination
stages.subtitle: Team Assembly
stages.description: Recruit and coordinate talent, crew, and on-camera participants

stages.label: Recording Sessions
stages.subtitle: Capture
stages.description: Capture unscripted footage across planned sessions
stages.ai: Monitors coverage, flags missing angles or segments

stages.label: Raw Footage Review
stages.subtitle: Selects & Logging
stages.description: Review, log, and select the best raw footage for editing
stages.ai: Analyzes footage quality, suggests best takes and moments

stages.label: Editing & Assembly
stages.subtitle: Edit & Build
stages.description: Assemble selected footage into rough and fine cuts
stages.ai: Suggests pacing improvements, checks narrative flow

stages.label: Stakeholder Approval
stages.subtitle: Review & Sign-off
stages.description: Present cut to stakeholders for feedback and final approval
stages.ai: Tracks feedback rounds, consolidates revision requests

stages.label: Final Delivery
stages.subtitle: Deliverables
stages.description: Render final deliverables in all required formats and specs
stages.ai: Validates delivery specs, generates QC report

stages.label: Distribution Planning
stages.subtitle: Release & Distribute
stages.description: Plan distribution channels, release schedule, and promotional strategy
stages.ai: Suggests optimal release timing, analyzes platform requirements
